calculation.description: Fade the signed intraday close-to-open move, normalized by the day's high-low range; higher values indicate stronger reversal pressure and are expected to predict higher next-day returns.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.069609; 617 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.053575; 410 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.022251; 492 dates), with attenuation in the latest regime. Cross-section is small and coverage is reduced by missing OHLC fields, so uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.
